Definition: feminine of apparently a primary word; "green"; Chloë, a Christian female:--Chloe.
BiblicalUsage: Chloe is a Christian woman in Corinth, named once, because her household told Paul the truth about the church. It was declared to Paul by them which are of the house of Chloe that there were contentions among the believers, and her name is the reason the first letter to the Corinthians was written.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chloe's household did the church a service by telling the truth, because a church cannot be healed until its divisions are named.
